reviews.title: Beautiful case, works well with a few tweaks
reviews.comment:
First Impressions:
First off, the case is beautiful and is built with quality.
- An all white build is a nice change and it doesn't show dust as bad as darker colors.
- This case does NOT have the iCUE option, or the fans that can be linked by iCUE.
- You have to use your RGB controller from your motherboard or other RGB controller.
- If you get a Corsair CPU water cooler with one, you can replace the case fans with iCUE fans later and link them together as there is a spot in the back of the motherboard mounting plate for an iCUE hub or 2.5" SATA Drives
Extra features:
The case has a lot of room* for a large motherboard build and some cool features
- Sliding mount for water coolers or large fans at the top
- Rotating PCIE slot mounting plate
- GPU Support bracket
- Thumbscrew PSU connection
- Lots of airflow and places to mount more fans
- Support for rear connection motherboards
- White magnetic strip to cover the gap from the motherboard to the case
Build:
- I built with a Gigabyte Aorus X870E Pro X3D ICE
- *I had to remove and flip the GPU support bracket over as the bracket was blocking a USB 3 header on the motherboard. This also prevented me from using the white magnetic strip to cover the gap between the motherboard and case.
- I changed the orientation of the water cooler radiator to allow the addition of a rear fan in case I wanted to add one later as there is not a lot of room in the top/rear of the case.
Functionality:
- Front USB ports and button work well
- With a water cooled, overclocked 9800X3D and a GeForce 3090, everything stays very cool in the case
- The stock fans are very quiet
- Plenty of room for PSU cable management with white 1000W Corsair PSU
- It is wider than other cases

reviews.title: BEST Case I have ever had !
reviews.comment: I really love this case.  I like the wrapped glass and the size of it.  This is a very good quality case.  The glass is thick and very transparent with a high quality glass. The Steele case is thick and well built as well.  It is very easy for cable management.  The three fans it comes with are very good quality and very quiet with nice and bright RGB color.  All the fans are daisy chained together so you only need one pwm fan and argb port.  I like the white banding in the glass on the top and bottom.  It hides the top fans.  This case is very easy to work with.  If I had to complain about anything it would be the top plastic feels like it might become brittle in years to come and it does not have a filter on the top but it does not need it but I know some cases have them.  You can always get filter by the sheet if you want to install it.  Great case, I will be getting another one for another build.  All my stuff stays cool and looks better in-person than in pics.
